caption: LUM-1306 — `/reload` in the real pi-rust TUI, captured on feature/pi.rs after the merge. The child runs with a prepared HOME (`--home /tmp/lum1306/home-reload`) holding `~/.pi/agent/keybindings.json` (cursorUp->Ctrl+P) and `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` (theme=light, fullscreenCopyOnSelect=false). Panels: (1) idle, (2) /hotkeys showing the on-disk override live, (3) /help, (4) /reload re-reading both files — the summary line names the file and the override count, the palette flips to the stored light theme, and the scope note states what is NOT re-read. Real binary + real PTY + pyte VT emulator; nothing mocked.

panels.label: 1. idle 120x34 — default palette; overrides on disk, nothing applied yet
2. /clear + /hotkeys + Home — the on-disk override is live before any reload (Ctrl+P)
3. /clear + /help + Home — the head of the command list
4. /clear + /reload — keybindings + settings re-read; light theme applied live; honest scope note
